message.content: YurikoYamamoto is seeking assistance from Li Hua in enhancing her studio's online presence through several initiatives aimed at improving communication and engagement with her clients. Specifically, she is discussing two projects: adding a blog section to her studio’s homepage and implementing a "leave a message" feature on her website. Additionally, she is requesting feedback on a new feature for automatically scheduling available time on her studio’s homepage. Li Hua is eager to collaborate and provide guidance to ensure these updates meet her expectations and effectively serve her clients.
